output: raw logits, no softmax in graph; probs = softmax(logits / temperature) from calibration.json
inputs_note: only input_ids and attention_mask; no position_ids, token_type_ids or sliding-window mask inputs (RoPE and the local/global attention masks are built inside the graph)

tokenizer.padding: right with pad_id; attention_mask 1 for real tokens, 0 for pad
tokenizer.raw_text: feed raw SMS text (no OTP or number masking), same as training

bucket_rule: S = smallest bucket >= len(ids) after truncation to 128; run signature f's{S}'

type.activations: float32, dynamically quantised to int8 per FC by XNNPACK
type.prep: exact offline randomized-Hadamard rotation of the residual stream (LayerNorm folded into projection + RMS) and per-head V/O rotation; fp32 graph equals HF within 1e-4

runtime.accelerator: CPU (XNNPACK); optional NPU via LiteRT Samsung Exynos AI LiteCore where it compiles the graph, otherwise CPU
runtime.kernels: XNNPACK qd8-qc8w GEMM (Arm i8mm/dotprod on Cortex-X925/A725)
runtime.xnnpack_weight_cache: required: set CpuOptions.xnnpack_weight_cache_path to a per-model file in noBackupFilesDir (e.g. type.xnn); first load packs (~350 MB file), later loads mmap it (RSS ~0.4 GB instead of ~1.4 GB); delete the cache file when the model sha256 changes
runtime.threads: 2-4, background priority (THREAD_PRIORITY_BACKGROUND); never more than the big+mid cores
runtime.residency: load on demand, unload after idle; single model (type); category is rules-first then ASK
runtime.guards: heavy batch work only while charging and thermal status < MODERATE (PowerManager.getCurrentThermalStatus); back off on THROTTLING; single-message inference allowed on battery
runtime.batching: batch=1 fixed shapes; pick bucket per message

privacy.note: trained on the owner's anonymised SMS (all identifiers replaced with same-shape random surrogates) plus public datasets; no identifier is recoverable; weak membership signal on anonymised rows
